item.description:
⚡ Refresh a reading where you see it, get fresh figures when your connection returns, and see each usage warning only once.

✨ New

  • ↻ Click the "updated" time on the card to read usage again; the separate refresh icon is gone.
  • 💬 The activity line now names Claude, Codex, or Copilot instead of saying "a model."
  • 📋 "Copy diagnostic info" in the notch menu copies a report of every CLI to your clipboard, ready for a bug report.
  • 🔓 Token Pacer's source is now public under the MIT license.

🔧 Fixed

  • 🔔 The usage warning no longer reappears every five minutes. Each mark shows once, and again only after usage drops back under it.
  • 📡 When a CLI can't connect, its row says so, and readings retry as soon as the network is back.
  • ⬇️ In-app update checks now use the app's public GitHub release feed.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
